integrity: The proof uses explicitly cited published kernel asymptotics and decay estimates, plus a separate wave-packet argument. Numerical checks are supplementary and finite. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
limitations: Fixed m>2, finitely many fixed alpha>0. Lower essential-norm bounds and common singular approximate spectrum only; no exact operator essential norm, full essential spectrum, or uniformity in m or alpha.
title: Common Gaussian Weyl curves for power-weight Fock Berezin transforms
